name: touitomamout-next
description: An easy way to synchronize your posts from X.com to other social media.

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:app && mkdir -p dist && PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH SCRIPTC_NO_CACHE=1 scriptc build src/scriptc-entry.ts --dynamic --ffi native/sqlite.ffi.json --no-keep-c -o dist/touitomamout
scripts.build:app: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.sql=text --alias:@the-convocation/twitter-scraper=./node_modules/@the-convocation/twitter-scraper/dist/default/esm/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; var require = createRequire(import.meta.url); var Intl = {}; var FormData = globalThis.FormData ?? class FormData {}; globalThis.FormData = FormData;" --outfile=packages/scriptc-app/dist/index.js
scripts.coverage: bun run build:app && scriptc coverage src/scriptc-entry.ts --dynamic --ffi native/sqlite.ffi.json
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && bun run build:app && PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH scriptc run src/scriptc-entry.ts --dynamic --ffi native/sqlite.ffi.json

author: Yamada Sexta
